number_sources.context: ## How should you use a LitRPG Con 2027 reader guide to plan authors and signings?
number_sources.kind: editorial event-year framing

number_sources.context: Use a LitRPG Con 2027 reader guide for authors and signings by locking in your top signing window and top panel each morning before adding casual side sessions. Leaving thirty minutes between a basement panel and an upstairs dealer hall queue keeps a ten-minute elevator wait from costing you an autograph.
number_sources.kind: editorial event-year framing

number_sources.context: First-time convention goers often make the mistake of treating the schedule grid like a college course catalog—packing every hour from 10:00 am to 6:00 pm with back-to-back panels. By Saturday at 2:00 pm, they are starving, carrying twelve pounds of books, and stuck at the back of a signing line that started twenty minutes ago.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: At LitRPG Con 2026, about 600 app users used the ConRoster planner, logging 1,135 quest completions from 223 users and about 16,000 schedule shares. When you build your 2027 itinerary inside the app, let the built-in conflict checker do the heavy lifting:
number_sources.kind: observed product figures

number_sources.context: We all love cheering for the authors whose ten-book series kept us awake until 3:00 am. Go see them! But the magic of a genre-specific convention happens when five authors sit down to argue about system design, monster evolution, or why crafting protagonists are so addictive to read.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: When you sit in a topic-driven panel, keep the author profiles open in the app. Because ConRoster's author pages (as of October 18, 2026) display books, covers, and series data straight from [LitRPG Tools](), you can tap a panelist who just made a hilarious point about loot tables and see their exact Book 1 cover and series order while they are still speaking. If you step up to the audience mic during Q&A, keep your question short and focused on the panel topic so all four or five authors on stage get a chance to answer.
number_sources.kind: approved editorial as-of date or roadmap statement

number_sources.context: When a panel finishes at 1:50 pm, volunteers usually need five to ten minutes to clear the stage and set microphones for the 2:00 pm session. Trying to corner an author with three hardcovers at the water pitcher slows down the room turnover and stresses out the panelists.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: 1. **Tap the author on your panel card:** See both their remaining panels and their linked dealer hall booth number on one screen.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: 2. **Check the interactive floor plan:** Follow the walking directions from your panel room to their aisle in the dealer hall.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: 3. **Browse their digital storefront:** Check whether their booth catalog shows limited-item badges (like "Limited · 5 left"), day-by-day pricing, or item hold and want options before you even reach the table.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: ## What should you do if a room changes at 2:10 pm or basement Wi-Fi drops?
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data

number_sources.context: Hotel conference floors can be tough on cell signals when hundreds of readers pack into a panel room. ConRoster is built as an offline convention app for hotel basements with bad Wi-Fi (live as of October 18, 2026): your loaded schedule and conflict checker stay readable even if your bars drop to zero underground. Whenever you step back into the main concourse and reconnect, any room changes sent by staff appear in your room-change inbox.
number_sources.kind: approved editorial as-of date or roadmap statement

number_sources.context: And when you have a free 25-minute gap between your afternoon panel and dinner, tap into the app's QR scavenger hunts, hint trails, or live room quizzes to earn XP toward your persistent convention level. Take a look at the [ConRoster attendee overview]() to see how personal schedules, author profiles, and quests fit together on your phone.
number_sources.kind: illustrative example, list ordinal or planning advice; not measured event data
